data.description:
## Context

The project has audience guidance distributed across AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/README.md, and individual documents. It lacks one current-state policy that distinguishes durable records, maintained documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence. The audit ticket minimum-rainy-fawn approved F01 and rejected broad prose cleanup and general prose validation.

## Current enforcement and history

Ticket forworn-zanyish-narwhale added generated markers, two contributor tables in docs/README.md, and tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py after repeated changes edited derived outputs instead of their sources. The test owns the GENERATED and GATED_HAND_AUTHORED collections and parses the tables from docs/README.md. CONTRIBUTING.md points to the existing landing-page anchor. This change preserves both collections, every catalog row, and all marker checks. It relocates the catalog so the landing page can remain a navigation surface.

## Plan

Add docs/documentation-policy.md as the current policy for tickets, ADRs, internal documentation, external documentation, shipped help, comments, generated artifacts, and protected evidence. Define the audience, purpose, lifecycle, canonical source, use of citations, correction method, exclusions, and examples for each category. Include the approved punctuation, paragraph-shape, diction, and formal-voice rules for new or edited maintained text. State that ticket events remain append-only and that ADR decision substance is preserved through annotations, errata, supersession, or replacement ADRs.

Add docs/generated-artifacts.md as the contributor inventory. Move the existing generated and parity-gated tables from docs/README.md without changing their rows. Update the existing marker test to parse the new inventory while preserving GENERATED and GATED_HAND_AUTHORED. Replace the old CONTRIBUTING.md anchor and add concise policy pointers in AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md.

## Exclusions

- No edits to generated outputs, ADR decision substance, ticket events, historical evidence, protected evidence, or commit history.
- No repository-wide prose rewrite.
- No prose or comment validator.
- No F05 ownership descriptor, generated catalog generator, or new ADR.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] docs/documentation-policy.md defines all eight documentation categories and gives each category an audience, purpose, lifecycle, canonical source, citation rule, correction method, exclusions, and at least one example.
- [ ] The policy states the approved punctuation, paragraph-shape, diction, and formal-voice rules for new or edited maintained text.
- [ ] The policy requires append-only ticket correction and substance-preserving ADR correction through annotations, errata, supersession, or a replacement ADR.
- [ ] docs/generated-artifacts.md contains the same generated and parity-gated table row sets that docs/README.md contained before this change.
- [ ] tests/unit/test_generated_surface_markers.py retains the existing GENERATED and GATED_HAND_AUTHORED values and passes while reading docs/generated-artifacts.md.
- [ ] AGENTS.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, and docs/README.md each link to docs/documentation-policy.md.
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md links to docs/generated-artifacts.md and no longer points to the removed docs/README.md generated-artifacts anchor.
- [ ] The targeted marker test, make lint, make typecheck, and the project test gate pass.
data.title: F01 Define documentation ownership policy
